description: Lays out a run of Sundays from a start date: each Sunday's name, season, color, lectionary year and appointed readings from the 1979 Book of Common Prayer lectionary, the seasons the run crosses, feasts that fall on those Sundays, and every book read on three or more consecutive Sundays, with the longest such run named as a possible series spine. Rule-based, no generated text.

focus.description: Look for the series spine in one reading only: first, second, gospel or psalm.

start_date.description: First date of the series, YYYY-MM-DD. A weekday starts at the next Sunday.

name: plan_sermon_series
title: Plan a sermon series
